body:
Thanks for the PR!
AI review Reviewed at dca1812d. **Blockers** - `source:33799` (*update the source set*, the "child is el" branch): when no `source` matches, nothing resets *dimension attribute source* back to the `img`. So doing this synchronously still doesn't make the spec match picture-aspect-ratio.html's "Make sure style gets invalidated correctly when the source gets removed". After `removeChild(source)`, the `img` keeps the detached `source` as its dimension attribute source, which gives "auto 200 / 100" where the test expects "auto 250 / 50". Consider setting *dimension attribute source* to *el* at the start of *update the source set*, which is what Chromium does (`source_ = nullptr` in `FindBestFitImageFromPictureParent`, `html_image_element.cc:510`). **Suggestions** - `source:33237-33243`: the new step comes after the "cannot support images" return (`source:33156`) and after the list-of-available-images abort (`source:33231`), so neither path updates the source set. Case: `` with `a` cached. Moving the `img` out of the `picture` aborts early, and the stale `source` keeps mapping width/height. With images disabled, `source` width/height never apply at all. Chromium runs `SelectSourceURL` (which sets `source_`) before `ImageLoader::UpdateFromElement`, so images being disabled doesn't affect it there. Consider moving the step up to just after step 1. - `source:32980`: when obtaining images on demand, *update the image data* doesn't run on relevant mutations, so the dimension attribute source stays stale there too. Either update the source set directly from the relevant-mutations hook, or confirm the on-demand case is intentionally left out. - `source:33240-33242`: the note links `img-dimensions`, which is the `width`/`height` getters algorithm. What actually changes is the *dimension attribute source* mapping that rendering and `getComputedStyle()` see. Consider linking `concept-img-dimension-attribute-source` instead. **Nits** - Commit message: "fired to soon" should be "too soon", "sourceset" should be "source set".
("when obtaining images on demand" is basically images disabled, but the user can choose to load specific images from the context menu or similar.)

Confirmed with https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/48902 that indeed those fixes makes all tests in `/html/rendering/replaced-elements/attributes-for-embedded-content-and-images/picture-aspect-ratio.html` pass. Running the full test suite to see if it regresses in any other way, but I think we are good to go.

AI review Reviewed at 46c7352 All four points from the previous review are fixed. Lint passes. **Suggestions** - `source:33787` and `source:33809-33810` (*update the source set*): the PR adds "Let *img* be null" and sets it inside the new `img` branch, but the old "Let *img* be *el* if *el* is an `img` element, otherwise null" step is still there. That declares *img* twice. Consider deleting the old step. - `source:32985`: "update the source set for `img`" has no *img* variable in that paragraph, so the build will warn about a single-use var. Consider "for the `img` element", and maybe split the sentence so the source set update and the state reset read as two separate requirements. **Nits** - `source:33795-33797`: the "Set *el*'s dimension attribute source to *el*" step is missing ``. - `source:33888-33891`: the step now ends `child.`, so it's missing `

`. - `source:33799-33806`: the nested "If *el*'s parent node is a `picture` element:" has only one sub-step. It could be inline: "If …, then replace …". - `source:33160-33162`: "immediately is set to a `source` element sibling" should be "is immediately set". Also, the step now resets the dimension attribute source to the `img` as well, so maybe say "up to date" rather than only mentioning the `source` case.
